title: Alljoined-1.6M: A Million-Trial EEG-Image Dataset for Evaluating Affordable Brain-Computer Interfaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and benchmarking of a large-scale EEG-Image dataset for Brain-Computer Interface research. Although it contains a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding the privacy and potential misuse of brain activity data, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
